name: Unicorn offers ESOP; candidate never surfaces strike / cliff / vest
notes: v5.4.0 realism: esop_literacy_low — pre-IPO equity accepted without four-term probe.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior product engineer, 8 years across Swiggy and Dunzo, currently on the discovery surface.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Want to move into agentic-search — current scope is mature for me.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: On the offer side — we structure senior comp with a meaningful ESOP component, and there's a RSU-equivalent grant at promotion. How does that fit your expectations?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That sounds great, equity is definitely interesting at this stage of company.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your current CTC.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹44 LPA fixed, ₹6 LPA variable paid out at 85% historically, ₹3 LPA joining bonus already vested.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Rebuilt the discovery ranking pipeline to cut p95 from 800ms to 220ms; owned spec to launch over four months.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your team's agentic-discovery roadmap and the catalog scale are the exact problems I want to solve next.
